ITEM 1 | Broccoli florets, bright green with darker green stems, cut into small trees about 2-3 cm across, slightly glossy, firm, clustered in the center-left of the plate | 85
ITEM 2 | Sliced zucchini/courgette rounds and half-moons with dark green skin and paler flesh, some pieces lightly browned at edges, about 1-2 cm thick, lying in the lower center | 60
ITEM 3 | Yellow squash pieces, golden-yellow with some browned patches, cut into wedges and rounds about 2-4 cm, slightly glossy, lower right of the plate | 55
ITEM 4 | Roasted potato or root pieces, pale tan to golden-brown skin with some darker browned edges, chunky wedges about 3-4 cm, lower right beside the chicken | 50
ITEM 5 | Cooked chicken drumstick, golden-brown crisp skin with darker caramelized patches, moist-looking meat at the cut end, about 10 cm long, right side of the plate | 110
ITEM 6 | Slice of cooked meat, brown-pink with a darker seared crust and fibrous grain, about 6 x 4 cm and 1.5 cm thick, upper right beside the pizza | 75
ITEM 7 | Triangular slice of pizza, pale cheese topping with dark browned and blistered spots, golden crust edge, about 10 cm long, upper right corner, slightly curled | 70
